verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents that it can "reimburse employees worldwide." Its spend-management AI checks expense receipts and audits reports before they reach approval, so an employee reimbursement flow exists in the product itself. The evidence centers on card spending, though, and never explicitly describes submitting an out-of-pocket expense, the payout rail or speed, or status tracking. missing for 10: explicit out-of-pocket expense submission flow, direct-deposit payout to the employee, documented payout timing in days, submission-to-payout status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: Track card spending and reimburse employees worldwide
Missing, unclear, or invalid receipts are flagged before they reach approval, reducing rework later.
Always-on checks to audit reports and apply your spend rules automatically, without slowing employees down.
Programmatically make cost effective, fast and secure global payouts
